hoy.titular: 20th star in the bag, minds on Montevideo
hoy.resumen: La Plata woke up celebrating the Supercopa: last night fans packed 7 y 50 after the 3-2 extra-time win over Independiente Rivadavia. Now only one thing remains: the Libertadores final against Palmeiras on Saturday 28th.
puntos: Coaches to Montevideo (ARS 50,000 return, in the UNO app): today, Friday 13, the remaining members; Saturday 14, general sale.
Seats for the final: sold out. The club will tell members if any more become available.
Saturday 14, 7pm to midnight: the Estudiantes Museum shows off its revamp at Museos a la Luz de la Luna, at the club headquarters (53 No. 620).

linea.texto: Chiqui Tapia did not travel to Córdoba for the trophy presentation: he congratulated the champions and Verón on social media.
Medina celebrated his first title at the club: "Today winning or losing was not the same", with the final in sight.
Party at 7 y 50: fans filled central La Plata to celebrate the 20th star.
Pepe Sosa has reached seven titles and is the Pincha's most decorated player of the 21st century.
Champions! The Pincha beat Independiente Rivadavia 3-2 after extra time in Córdoba.
The winning goal: an Alario header in extra time, from a Baltasar Rodríguez set-piece delivery.

noticias.bajada: Carrillo and an own goal made it 2-0, Rivadavia levelled in stoppage time and Alario won it in extra time. Medina was sent off.
